title: seo: Deploy and verify exact production metadata
description:
## Goal
Make one controlled frontend deployment after all SEO code children close, then prove the exact public deployment matches the tested static export.

## Preconditions
All six implementation children closed with lint/build/check evidence. Working tree contains only task changes plus known Beads interaction state. Git index and remote must be writable. Current audit environment reports .git read-only; Luna must test rather than assume. Cloudflare identity must match the account owning Pages project vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask.

## Workflow
1. bd show this ID; bd update this ID --claim.
2. git status --short --branch. If unrelated user changes exist, preserve them and stop for scope guidance when overlap exists.
3. npx wrangler whoami. If unauthenticated or wrong account, update bead blocked with exact output; do not claim production proof.
4. npm run lint; npm run build; run SEO regression check.
5. Commit only SEO files and bead export, then git pull --rebase and git push. If .git is read-only, capture error and request a writable checkout; do not bypass with GitHub API unless user authorizes it.
6. npm run deploy (already runs lint/build and deploys Pages). Capture deployment URL/id.
7. Fetch exact live URLs: /, /about, /services, /work/newsharness, one Thinking post, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml. Check status 200; exact self-canonical; route-specific OG/Twitter; JSON-LD parse; no broken local image; sitemap parity.
8. Re-run git status and git push until branch is up to date. Update bead with deployment and live evidence, then close.

## Do not infer
A green local build, Cloudflare authentication, or adjacent Worker health is not deployment proof. Only exact Pages response after this deploy counts.
design: One deploy after all code children. No API Worker deployment: SEO changes are frontend-only.
acceptance_criteria: Correct Cloudflare account verified; lint/build/regression check pass; scoped commit pushed and branch up to date; Pages deployment succeeds; sampled exact live routes return 200 with corrected canonical/social/schema output; robots and sitemap live checks pass; deployment URL/id and command evidence recorded.
notes: Cloudflare identity PASS: random.planzz@gmail.com, account 7147002c38b170a24340e0598e215bc9. Local npm run lint PASS; npm run build PASS; npm run check:metadata PASS. npm run deploy PASS for Pages project vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask; deployment URL https://91dce8c4.vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask.pages.dev. Exact production project URL and sampled /, /about, /services, /work/newsharness, /thinking/cloudflare-native-news-intelligence-agent, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml all returned HTTP 200. Live checks confirmed self-canonical/og:url/og:image/twitter:image, Article url/mainEntityOfPage/Person author, WebSite/Person/ProfessionalService schema, no Review markup or missing project image refs, 16 sitemap URLs, sourced lastmod, and exact robots sitemap URL. git pull --rebase PASS; deployment was frontend-only; no API Worker deploy.
close_reason: Pages deployment succeeded and exact production metadata, schema, images, robots, and sitemap checks passed.

title: seo: Fix self-canonicals and route social metadata
description:
## Current gap
Generated and live HTML prove all non-home routes canonicalize to the homepage. Non-post routes inherit homepage Open Graph/Twitter values. Thinking titles append Vijay Kumaran twice; posts lose og:url, og:image, and twitter:image.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. npm run build.
2. Inspect out/about.html: canonical and og:url point to the homepage; OG/Twitter copy is homepage copy.
3. Inspect any out/thinking/*.html: canonical points home, title suffix is duplicated, and social URL/images are absent.
4. Compare the same tags on the live /about and one live Thinking post; defects reproduce.

## Scope
Use Next.js Metadata API to give every indexable route its own absolute canonical, og:url, title, description, and complete Open Graph/Twitter fields. Keep /og.png as truthful fallback. Fix title composition without visible-copy changes.

## Workflow
Claim bead; capture baseline in notes; make smallest reusable metadata helper only if used across routes; add Node-stdlib regression check for all 16 sitemap routes and /404 noindex; run npm run lint, npm run build, and check; update evidence; do not deploy from this child.

## Prior issue
vijay-kumaran-portfolio-jwy was closed, but its acceptance criterion is unmet.
design: Root metadata may keep homepage defaults, but nested objects are shallowly replaced by Next.js. Each route metadata object must therefore provide complete alternates/openGraph/twitter values or call a small shared helper. Do not add a dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All 16 sitemap routes emit exactly one absolute self-referencing canonical; all emit route-correct og:url, og:title, og:description, twitter:title, twitter:description, summary_large_image, and an image; Thinking titles contain Vijay Kumaran once; /404 remains noindex; npm run lint, npm run build, and the committed metadata regression check pass.

title: SEO remediation handoff: metadata, schema, assets, indexing
description:
## Goal
Repair current technical SEO defects proven in the 2026-08-05 local static export and live Pages deployment. Preserve the existing visual design, static-export architecture, and truthful-content policy.

## Proven baseline
npm run build passes and emits 17 HTML pages. Every content route has one H1 and a description. robots.txt allows crawling and references a 16-URL sitemap. Live /about and one Thinking post reproduce local metadata defects.

## Execution order
1. Claim this epic, then run bd ready --json and claim one ready child at a time.
2. Complete canonical/social/title regression first because wrong canonicals can suppress route indexing.
3. Complete structured-data cleanup and site identity.
4. Complete Thinking article metadata/images and project-image integrity.
5. Deploy once after all code children pass; then run live verification.
6. Search Console/Bing evidence is a human-access gate: never claim completion without screenshots or exported evidence.

## Boundaries
No redesign, no new runtime dependency, no fake testimonials/ratings/metrics/screenshots, no invented modified dates, no custom domain work without a separate human decision. Keep changes surgical.
design: Use Next.js Metadata API and existing data modules. Add one small metadata regression check if needed; no SEO framework. Validate generated out/*.html before deployment, then repeat against exact live URLs.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are closed with command evidence; npm run lint and npm run build pass; deployed HTML has self-canonical URLs and route-specific social metadata; structured data follows current Google guidance; no broken project image requests; indexing submission is either proven or explicitly blocked on human access.
notes:
Audit evidence 2026-08-05:
- Current branch master; npm run build PASS, 17 HTML pages (16 indexable + 404).
- Live /about HTTP 200 and live HTML reproduces canonical/OG homepage leakage.
- Live Thinking sample reproduces homepage canonical, duplicate title suffix, missing og:url/og:image/twitter:image.
- All generated content pages have one H1 and descriptions.

title: Fix mobilePlanets hydration mismatch
description: SpaceField.tsx mobilePlanets() runs during render behind typeof window check: server HTML has 3 planets, mobile client renders 2 → React hydration mismatch on every mobile load. Fix: compute in useEffect/useState mounted pattern, or render all and hide via CSS.
design: Replace render-time mobilePlanets() with useState(false) mounted + useEffect matchMedia check; until mounted render desktop list (matches SSR), or always render all planets and hide the 3rd via CSS media class.
acceptance_criteria: No hydration warning in mobile viewport; planet count consistent between SSR and client.

title: Fix reduced-motion resize leaving stale starfield
description: SpaceField.tsx: the reduce early-return (render once, line ~114) runs before the resize listener is registered (line ~155). Reduced-motion users who resize/orientation-change get a blank or stretched canvas. Fix: register a lightweight resize handler (resize + re-render static frame) before the reduce return.
design: Move resize listener registration above the reduce early-return; in reduce mode onResize should resize() + render() only (no star regen needed, or regen is fine — keep simple).
acceptance_criteria: With prefers-reduced-motion on, resizing the window re-renders the static starfield at the new size.

title: Fix planet drift snap-jump + desync planet loops
description: SpaceField.tsx:188-194. Planet x/y are single values with repeat:Infinity and times:[0,.5,1] — they animate 0→drift then teleport to 0 every 9s. Also all 3 planets share the same 9s duration/start, pulsing in sync. Fix: keyframe arrays [0,drift,0] for x/y, per-planet durations (7/9/11s) and phase offsets.
design: In planet motion.button animate: change x/y to [0, p.drift[0], 0] and [0, p.drift[1], 0]; move transition per-planet: duration 7+i*2 (7/9/11s), keep times [0,.5,1] easeInOut repeat Infinity.
acceptance_criteria: Planets drift back and forth smoothly with no visible jump; the three loops are visibly out of sync.

title: seo: Prove Google and Bing sitemap submission
description:
## Evidence gap
Prior bead vijay-kumaran-portfolio-h2j was closed without close reason, screenshots, exported report, or notes proving Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools ownership/submission. The claim remains unverified.

## Scope
After corrected production metadata is deployed, verify the exact URL-prefix property https://vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask.pages.dev/ (or existing domain property that demonstrably covers it). Submit https://vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask.pages.dev/sitemap.xml to Google and Bing. Capture non-secret evidence of property coverage, submission timestamp, and accepted/success status. Do not store credentials, cookies, tokens, verification TXT values, or screenshots containing account secrets in Git/Beads.

## Luna handoff workflow
1. Claim only after ers.7 closes.
2. Ask user to open or authenticate Search Console/Bing in an interactive browser session. This is a required human gate; do not use guessed credentials.
3. Confirm selected property exactly covers the Pages hostname.
4. Inspect existing sitemap entry before adding a duplicate. If already submitted, capture current success/last-read evidence instead.
5. Submit/refresh sitemap in Google. Use Bing import-from-GSC only if user approves; otherwise submit directly.
6. Use URL Inspection on homepage, /about, /work/newsharness, and one Thinking post after recrawl is available. Request indexing only where appropriate; do not spam repeated requests.
7. Record redacted evidence paths and observed statuses in bead notes. Close only when both engines are proven; otherwise mark the exact human/external blocker.

## Safety
Never commit authentication artifacts. A locally reachable sitemap or robots reference is not proof of webmaster-tool submission.
design: Human-authenticated browser task after deployment. No code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Redacted evidence proves the exact Pages property is owned/covered; sitemap is present and accepted/successful in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; submission/last-read timestamps and inspected URLs are recorded; no secrets are stored. If access is unavailable, bead remains open/blocked with exact requested human action.
notes: Blocked at required human-authenticated webmaster-tools gate after ers.7 deployment. Production sitemap is verified at https://vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask.pages.dev/sitemap.xml, but no authenticated interactive Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools session is available in this runtime. Do not claim submission acceptance without property coverage and accepted/last-read evidence. Required next action: user authenticates both tools for https://vijay-kumaran-portfolio-ask.pages.dev/; then inspect existing entries and submit/refresh the exact sitemap without exposing credentials.

title: seo: Complete Thinking article metadata and schema
description:
## Current gap
All four Article JSON-LD objects omit url/mainEntityOfPage and image. Generated post social metadata currently omits og:image/twitter:image; ers.1 fixes the generic fallback. Google recommends Article image and a resolvable author URL/type. Current author/publisher @id references must resolve cleanly.

## Scope
For each of four Thinking posts, complete Article metadata with canonical url/mainEntityOfPage and an author reference that resolves to the existing Person. Add an image only when it truthfully represents the article. Preferred: four simple content-grounded 1200x630 editorial cards using title/topic and existing visual system. Prohibited: fake product screenshots, fake metrics, stock imagery implying work, or invented dateModified. If real unique images cannot be made, document that and retain generic social fallback without falsely claiming Article-image completion.

## Workflow
1. Claim after ers.1.
2. Decide image path from truthful assets; record decision before creating files.
3. Add per-post image field to data/posts.ts only if images exist.
4. Keep generateMetadata and Article JSON-LD fed from same post record.
5. Build; parse all four post HTML files. Assert canonical URL, Article url/mainEntityOfPage, headline, description, datePublished, author resolution, and social image consistency.
6. Validate one deployed sample later in Google Rich Results Test during final verification; child stays code-only.
design: Keep posts as source of truth. No CMS, schema package, or image-generation dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All four post schemas parse and match visible title/excerpt/date; each has canonical url/mainEntityOfPage and resolvable Person author; no invented dateModified; social/schema images are content-grounded when included; all four generated pages pass the regression check; lint/build pass.
notes: Decision: no truthful unique editorial images currently exist, so Article image is omitted and generic /og.png remains social fallback. Added Article url, WebPage mainEntityOfPage, typed Person author, and kept post record as source for metadata/schema. Evidence: npm run lint PASS; npm run build PASS; npm run check:metadata PASS, including four parsed Article schemas with matching headline/description/date, canonical URL, mainEntityOfPage, author, and no dateModified.
close_reason: Article schemas now carry canonical URL, main entity, typed Person author, and regression evidence; no unsupported article images were claimed.

title: seo: Eliminate broken project thumbnail requests
description:
## Current gap
Generated HTML requests four missing assets: /projects/memory-os.avif, /projects/chronoquill.avif, /projects/artsports-content-os.avif, and /projects/mnemos.avif. ProjectThumb hides each only after a browser error. Rendered img tags omit intrinsic dimensions.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. npm run build.
2. Scan img src values across out/*.html.
3. Compare local src paths with public/: the four paths above do not exist.
4. Inspect components/ProjectThumb.tsx: src is synthesized from every slug and recovery occurs only in onError.

## Scope
Use an explicit truthful asset map. Add real visuals only with provenance; otherwise omit img before render. Never fabricate screenshots. Add intrinsic dimensions or stable aspect ratio, and remove slug-derived fallback alt when no asset exists.

## Workflow
Claim; inventory data/projects.ts against public/projects; record source/no-image choice; build; scan all HTML so every local img exists, has descriptive alt, and stable sizing; run npm run lint and npm run build; record evidence.
design: Prefer an explicit asset map and omission over client-side onError recovery. No image library.
acceptance_criteria: No generated HTML references a missing local image; no fake/placeholder screenshot is added; all rendered content images have descriptive alt and stable layout sizing; existing visual system is preserved; lint/build pass.
notes: Inventory found real assets only for newsharness, kpdc-trifecta, and steelmade. ProjectThumb now uses an explicit map, omits missing images before render, removes onError/useState, preserves existing alt text, and applies aspect-[1200/630]. Evidence: npm run lint PASS; npm run build PASS; npm run check:metadata PASS for 16 routes including local image existence and alt checks. No images fabricated; no deployment.
close_reason: Explicit truthful asset map removes missing image requests; generated image, alt, sizing, lint, and build checks pass.

title: seo: Verify sitemap submission to Google Search Console and Bing

title: seo: Add Mumbai base location to ProfessionalService schema
description:
## Current gap
"Mumbai, India" only exists in footer text — invisible to schema parsers. The ProfessionalService JSON-LD has areaServed: Worldwide (correct for global freelancer) but no location indicating where Vijay is based. Mumbai is the work base, not the service area.

## Scope
Enhance the root layout ProfessionalService schema with a location property: PostalAddress with addressLocality: Mumbai, addressRegion: Maharashtra, addressCountry: IN. Do NOT add LocalBusiness schema or geo meta tags — this is a global freelancer, not a local business. Keep areaServed: Worldwide.

## Acceptance criteria
- ProfessionalService schema includes location with Mumbai PostalAddress
- areaServed remains Worldwide
- No LocalBusiness schema (wrong category for global freelancer)
- Schema validates in Google Rich Results Test
- Build + lint pass
- No visual changes

title: seo: Add keyword-supporting H2 on homepage
description:
## Current gap

title: seo: Make sitemap signals accurate and regression-tested
description:
## Current gap
The live sitemap lists all 16 content routes, but every URL carries changefreq and priority values Google explicitly ignores, while no URL has lastmod. Manual XML can drift from generated static routes as more posts/case studies are added. The prior submission bead was closed without recorded acceptance evidence.

## Scope
Keep one sitemap at /sitemap.xml. Remove ignored changefreq/priority noise. Add lastmod only where an accurate source exists (post publication date is acceptable; do not invent dates for evergreen routes). Extend the metadata regression check from ers.1, or add one Node-stdlib check, to compare sitemap URLs with generated indexable HTML routes and reject missing/extra/duplicate/noncanonical URLs.

## Workflow
1. Claim after ers.1.
2. Choose public/sitemap.xml or Next MetadataRoute; use the smaller maintainable option under static export.
3. Update accurate fields only.
4. npm run build; run sitemap parity check against out/*.html excluding 404.
5. Confirm public/robots.txt still references exact absolute sitemap URL.
6. Record commands/results; do not submit or deploy from this child.
design: Accuracy over decorative fields. Do not use build time as lastmod for unchanged pages and do not add a sitemap package.
acceptance_criteria: Sitemap contains each of 16 indexable canonical routes exactly once; no 404; no ignored priority/changefreq fields; lastmod appears only where backed by source data; robots reference is correct; parity regression check, lint, and build pass.
notes: Kept public/sitemap.xml as the single static sitemap. Removed changefreq/priority noise; added lastmod only from the four data/posts.ts publication dates. Extended npm run check:metadata to reject duplicate/missing/extra sitemap routes, compare generated HTML route parity, validate canonical URLs, and verify robots.txt sitemap reference. Evidence: node --check scripts/check-metadata.mjs PASS; npm run lint PASS; npm run build PASS; npm run check:metadata PASS for 16 routes. No deployment/submission.
close_reason: Sitemap signals and generated-route parity are accurate and regression-tested.

title: Enhance: ProgressCounter count-up
description: 'Systems unlocked: n/11' should tick up when secret found — closes feedback loop RevealToast starts.
design: On count change animate displayed number from prev to new over .4s (rAF or motion animate onMotionValue). Trigger via existing storage event path.

title: Enhance: route transition fade
description: Site hard-cuts between routes despite in-page polish. Fast shared fade/slide on navigation.
design: app/template.tsx: motion.div key=pathname initial {opacity:0,y:8} animate {1,0} duration .25 EASE. Reduced-motion: instant.

title: Enhance: progressive AskTheWork answer reveal
description: Answer pops as full markdown block. Reveal progressively to match assistant framing.
design: Simplest: split rendered answer into top-level blocks, stagger fade/slide each (0.08). No fake typewriter — real chunks, no stream parsing.

title: Enhance: shooting star event in spacefield
description: Every 8-15s one star streaks across canvas with fading trail. Uniform motion becomes observed sky.
design: In tick: timer picks random interval; spawn meteor {x,y,vx,vy,life:1} crossing diagonal; draw line with gradient alpha = life; life -= dt*1.5; remove at 0. Skip when reduce/mobile.

title: Enhance: magnetic hero CTA buttons
description: Hero CTAs drift a few px toward cursor within small radius, spring back on leave. Fits tic-tac-toe playfulness.
design: Wrapper on ButtonLink: pointermove within 40px radius → x/y = delta*0.3 via useMotionValue+useSpring(stiffness 150 damping 15); leave → 0. pointer:fine only.

title: Enhance: word-by-word tagline reveal
description: 'Built to reduce manual work.' reveals per-word (opacity/y, ~30ms stagger) — thesis statement gets weight.
design: Split into word spans inside one HeroItem; variants staggerChildren 0.03, y 8→0. Reduced-motion: instant.

title: Enhance: section-label rule draw
description: Mono section labels draw a 1px rule (scaleX 0→1) alongside text reveal; ties sections together.
design: Add span rule to SectionLabel, animate via variants in the existing reveal (scaleX with EASE, origin left). Reduced-motion: full width instantly.

title: Enhance: cursor glow on project cards
description: Radial glow tracks pointer within each Selected-work card. Matches spacefield parallax language.
design: On card pointermove set CSS vars --mx/--my (no react state); card background: radial-gradient(200px at var(--mx) var(--my), rgba(34,211,238,.08), transparent). Desktop only via pointer:fine media.

title: Enhance: scroll-driven hero exit
description: Spacefield/hero currently hard-cuts at section boundary on scroll. Fade + parallax canvas and hero copy at different rates as hero scrolls away.
design: useScroll({target: heroRef, offset:['start start','end start']}) → useTransform: canvas opacity 1→0, copy y 0→-60. motion style on existing wrappers; reduced-motion skips via MotionConfig.
